verdict.rationale: Okta documents SCIM-based provisioning integrations, and SCIM's CRUD operations on user resources imply deprovisioning to connected apps. Event hooks fire on org events and could drive downstream offboarding automation. None of the evidence shows that deactivating a user in a single action terminates active sessions or deprovisions across all connected apps immediately. missing for 10: explicit documentation that user deactivation triggers deprovisioning across SCIM-connected apps, session revocation on deactivation, timing/immediacy guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration of the offboarding flow
